results.title: The `superseded` review state
results.evidence: 'superseded' is one of the 4 states the review vocabulary publishes at GET /api/v1/document-review/asks, and no code path in `core/docs/review.py` writes it — `comment` opens, `resolve` writes resolved, `withdraw` writes withdrawn, and nothing writes this. A client filtering or reporting on it filters on a state that cannot occur, which reads as 'none of those' rather than as 'that never happens h
